title: Xand van Tulleken: The wellness industry is a distraction
gist: Profile of doctor-broadcaster Xand van Tulleken, whose book Make Me Well argues the multitrillion-dollar wellness industry (supplements, collagen, personalised nutrition, wearables, private blood tests) creates value for sellers rather than buyers, rests on weak or industry-funded evidence, and distracts from social causes of ill health.

insights.claim: The multitrillion-dollar wellness industry creates astonishing value, but not for the people who buy its products; many promised benefits of collagen, high-strength vitamins, fish oils and personalised nutrition do not exist.
insights.speaker: Alicia Clegg
insights.so_what: Category growth rests on marketing, exposing it to regulatory and reputational risk.
